steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: The buildings here are so different from the other tribes...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Crappy houses!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hm, the architecture and decor is all pretty crude.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Got a lotta weird, broken gizmos all over the place too.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Zumama, you've got a very unique tribe here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Looks like they enjoy fiddling around with machines just as much as you do.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: This is my people's masterpiece.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yes. They now know the charm of the machines, and they have built the tribe you see here on their passion alone.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Look, it's Gavial!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: The Great Chief wasn't lying. She's planning to duel Gavial again with the Big Ugly.

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: What?! No way I can miss that!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Wow, there's so many people!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Many of them are from other tribes who've came here after the ceremony. They will be joining us.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So, what did you want to say?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Gavial, if you just left without a fuss, I wouldn't have cared. But since you're standing before me once again, I will defeat you right here and now.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Because you're too strong, Gavial.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Do you still remember that day?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That day?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Before that day, I was just like you. I believed the strength in my fists was everything.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Ahhhh!

steps.name: Old Archosauria
steps.text: Gavial wins!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha, I win again.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Hmph, another rematch! I'll definitely win this time!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Sure!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Eh, why is the ground shaking?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Look over there!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Wh- what's that?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's a big hunk of metal!

steps.name: Old Archosauria
steps.text: That is a Sargon nomadic city...

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What's a Sargon?

steps.name: Old Archosauria
steps.text: Sargon is our country.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Then what's a nomadic city?

steps.name: Old Archosauria
steps.text: A nomadic city is a very large tribe, with many people living in it.

steps.name: Old Archosauria
steps.text: I visited once, when I was young.

steps.name: Old Archosauria
steps.text: Don't be afraid. It won't come over here.

steps.name: Old Archosauria
steps.text: It will never have anything to do with us.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Zumama, what is it? Are you feeling sick?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: No. I'm going home.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, I remember. A Sargon nomadic city was passing pretty close to us that day. You turned all weird after that.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I think you're the weird one, Gavial.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: How could you not feel astonished after seeing something like that? How could you not be shocked? How could you not feel like a tiny speck of dust?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I mean, I guess I felt something like 'Wow, that's big.' But what's a big thing got to do with me?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: That's our Gavial.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But that's the day I lost interest in fighting with you.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I asked Inam to help me find books on machinery, and began studying Sargonian and mechanical engineering.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Then I met the High Priest, and we began building the Big, Ugly Thing together.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I know. I did go to look for you after all.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? Does that mean that the weirdo over there is your invisible friend?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: That's right!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Woah! When did you get here?!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: This feller's got the same energy as my Baws, the Emperor...

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Emperor? Are you talking about that penguin?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sure am. Hold on a minute, you know the Baws?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Of course, of course I do. Though it's been a couple of decades since we last met... Eh, was it a few decades? Or a few centuries? Doesn't matter. I can smell him on you.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: What's that about a few centuries...?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Lordy loo! Who'da thunk I'd meet a friend of the Baws out here!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So you really do exist. I always thought Zumama got messed up in the head and hallucinated you. I was even researching similar cases at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, don't you know, Gavial? Whenever you came to look for Zumama, I was always there watching!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Just like this!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: He disappeared!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Hahaha, I wouldn't normally show myself to you, but since I want to pilot the Big Ugly, I have no choice!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Building machines with the little ones is actually a lot of fun!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Speaking of the Big Ugly, shouldn't somebody be driving it? 'cause I'm pretty sure it's about to crash into that house.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Huh? Oh, crap! Gotta go!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Wow, he popped back into that thing quick. Badass.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: He'n the Boss really are birds of a feather, huh...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, right, our conversation. Zumama, let's get to the point, if we're gonna fight anyway do we really have to talk about all this stuff?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I have things to say to you, and to myself.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Did you know, Gavial? You were always my biggest obstacle.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Really?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Well, not just you, but people like you.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I've tried so many times to teach people about the charm of the machines. But in the end, they're never interested.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Because they look up to strong people, like you.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You teach them that, in this place, you get what you want when you're strong.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It's your strength that stands in the way of progress.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: So I decided to change the way they think. I'm going to use an even greater power to destroy this blind worship of strength that you created.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Well, that makes sense to me. What do you think, Doctor?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, whose side are you on?!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Sounds like yer talkin' sense, but it still don't feel right, somehow...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hell yeah! That big clanker's badass!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Honestly, I'm almost convinced myself.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But I never wanted to be anyone's role model. When I say fists solve problems, that's just me talking. It's got nothing to do with anyone else.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I know, I'm not blaming you.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Even so, Gavial, I want to defeat you with the power of the Big Ugly.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Everyone, listen up!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: The Big Ugly will be dueling Gavial once again!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: This battle will decide who is the real Great Chief!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: High Priest, it's time to fight!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: You got it!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Are you ready, Gavial? Your friends can join the fight too!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Finally!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Step back, everybody. This one's mine.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Come at me!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Let's test its performance first!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Fire!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Heh, don't think you'll hit me a second time!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Ah, those are the reflexes I'd expect from Gavial! No problem. Have a taste of my great iron fist!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: A test of strength, huh? Sounds good to me!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Wow, Gavial's strong!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Crazy strong! She stopped its fist all by lonesome!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I know I asked way back when I got my first physical, but why is she a medic again?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: ...You may be my opponent, but I can't help but cheer for you!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: It's not over yet though! The Big Ugly has a max performance mode for just such an occasion!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Go!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: That big guy looks stronger!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: And it's suppressing Gavial's strength?!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, what a melodious sound...! Hm? Wait, these readings are strange... Whaaa?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: High Priest, what's going on?!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Waah, my butt's being cooked!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I'm talking about the Big Ugly!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, I was just sharing my status as well. I think the engine output is too high. I'm losing control of the Big Ugly!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: It's actually quite exhilarating!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Get out of there!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Aren't we fighting? Let's just fight like this! Come, Gavial, I'll finish this once and for all——

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: High Priest!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, fine. What a shame. Looks like I'll have to change tactics.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Zumama, don't worry about me, I'll do my best to stabilize it. You find a way to stop the Big Ugly in the meantime!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...Gavial, you and your people get out of here. This isn't your business.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What are you talking about? Don't you want to beat me?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I do. But not like this.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Come on. Of course I'm going to help. Right, Doctor?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Fight the monster! I'll help!

options: Turns out we do have to help.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Eh, you want me to fight that big guy? Really? What a pain.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I'm gettin' overtime for this one, Baws! Triple rate!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Doctor, don't just sit there and enjoy the show! It's time to take command.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You are kind of a pain sometimes, Doctor.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Go and prepare to take command!
